claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: AM-251 at 2.5 uM likely kills cells through a cationic amphiphilic drug (CAD) lysosomal stress mechanism, driven by its lipophilic piperidine/amide structure rather than cannabinoid receptor antagonism.
